subject: Manually set/force initial values of the latent field

messages.author: e7cc390b005447b3
messages.subject: Manually set/force initial values of the latent field
parts:
Hi,

I have performed some runs of the inla-function. I do not get the same results and think that the initial values might be computed differently in each run. 

Before I could set control.mode=list(x=x,theta=THETA,restart = TRUE). What is the correct way now? Here x could be e.g som vector of zeros. 

Best
Fredrik

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Manually set/force initial values of the latent field
parts:
in general, you would likely not want to set x=x in control.mode, the format of
it is c(APredictor, Predictor, latent), and you kind of have to know the
dimensions and what is what.

if you want to set it to zero, then its rep(0, len), where you have to to a
test-run to find 'len'
